summary: Bars executive branch agencies and employees from entering into or requiring non-disclosure agreements for data center projects; creates a Data Center Planning and Community Engagement Toolkit for localities; expedites state data center noise regulations; directs a review of diesel and other backup generation; directs data center investment toward local energy projects; develops workforce best practices; creates an AI Task Force.

source.citation: Governor of Virginia news release, Sept 18, 2026 (lists Executive Order 22 actions)

confidence_note: Read on the Governor's release; the order text itself not read. Whether the order removes large projects from state fast-track permitting (reported by Bay Journal) is not stated among the release's order actions.
